# Re-read the data with proper parsing for revenue
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data again
print("Shape:", sales_df.shape)
print("\nColumn types:\n", sales_df.dtypes)
print("\nValue counts for customer_segment:\n", sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())
print("\nValue counts for channel:\n", sales_df['channel'].value_counts())
print("\nValue counts for status:\n", sales_df['status'].value_counts())
print("\nValue counts for converted:\n", sales_df['converted'].value_counts())
print("\nMissing values:\n", sales_df.isnull().sum())"}
